product_metadata.title: iDesign Pebblz Suction Non-Slip Square Bath Mat for Shower, Bathtub, Stall, 22" x 22", Blue
features: SHOWER MAT: Plastic bath mat with pebble design is perfect to create a spa-like atmosphere in bath tubs, showers, and shower stalls. Water flows through the pebbles for easy draining. Ideal for master bathroom, guest bathroom, kid's bathroom, and college dorm bathroom
NON-SLIP DESIGN: Suction cups on bottom keep mat in place for worry-free showering
DURABLE: Made of durable blue plastic for years of quality use
ADJUSTABLE SIZE: Plastic cuts easily if mat needs to be trimmed
IDEAL SIZE: Bath mat measures 22" x 22", perfect for your shower stall
description: Give your feet something secure and cool to step on with the iDesign Pebblz Bath Mat. This translucent, flexible blue shower mat offers smooth and textured faux pebbles beneath your feet, giving your bathtub a look that hearkens back to nature and looks even better in the water. Adorning the bottom of the mat are numerous suction cups that stick to your bathtub to ensure a slip-free wash. Soft, pliable plastic construction cuts easily with scissors or a blade to provide an exact fit. The iDesign Pebblz Bath Mat measures 22" x 22", perfect for your shower stall. With iDesign by InterDesign, you can #LiveSimply every day.
